transcription_check.checked_by: Codex translator agent translate_56_75; same agent, not independent expert review
transcription_check.scope: All 20 rendered PDF pages visually compared with extraction. Images retained in tmp/pdfs/pages-0506-0525/. Three bold heading lines excluded and separately preserved. Visually joined lines on page 511 retain the two extracted source segments as provisional lineation. Verification concerns this defective digital witness, not an original performance or complete critical text.

alignment_check.scope: All 829 source/English pairs read in order; repeated lines, names, numbers, source defects, and page transitions checked. Lexical and line-alignment corrections rechecked. No independent expert review.

notes.manas-2010:p0506:b001:l001: Continues the commanders’ speech from page 505; no new opening or completion is invented at this batch boundary.
notes.manas-2010:p0506:b001:l007: Барбактап evokes the movement/appearance of Zholoy’s large frame; swaying is a contextual rendering, not a specific gait recorded elsewhere.
notes.manas-2010:p0506:b001:l015: Калдай is read as governor, with кан retained as khan. The capitalized source may also treat Kalday as a title-name; no separate official is invented. Shared lexicon: https://el-sozduk.kg/калдай/.
notes.manas-2010:p0506:b001:l026: Көк күбө тон is blue/steel-blue mail or armor clothing, not a witness’s robe; the exact armor construction is not supplied.
notes.manas-2010:p0506:b001:l028: The blue tiger image is preserved. It is heroic coloration, not an identification of a biological species.
notes.manas-2010:p0506:b001:l036: The source has battle-axe impact amid an alarm although it compares the uproar to an enemy arrival. The striking/splintering and ellipsis are retained; a new actual battle is not inferred.
notes.manas-2010:p0506:b003:l001: Калдай жарым кандары: lesser khans provisionally renders жарым, literally half. Rank coordination is uncertain, and raw wording is retained. This sole verse follows the bold editorial heading.
notes.manas-2010:p0507:b001:l002: Кечил is rendered monk throughout this batch, including monks serving in the epic army. It is not mechanically treated as a personal name.
notes.manas-2010:p0507:b001:l004: Таштуу means possessing a stone; in the officials’ context it is a gemstone badge of rank. The exact gemstone and office are not inferred.
notes.manas-2010:p0507:b001:l009: Көбүнчө normally often/mostly; exceedingly high is a provisional reading of this description. The scope of the adverb is uncertain.
notes.manas-2010:p0507:b001:l018: The source says banner that bows the earth; the draft retains this hyperbole rather than silently changing туу to кол, army.
notes.manas-2010:p0507:b001:l021: Кызыталак is an abusive sexual/kinship curse; bastard is a forceful English equivalent, not a genealogical claim. Repetitions of the insult are retained.
notes.manas-2010:p0507:b001:l022: Forty days is explicit and retained, without harmonizing the shorter battle durations in the following account.
notes.manas-2010:p0507:b001:l026: Бөлөктөрү is interpreted as his other men/companions, finishing the fugitives. Pronoun reference to Manas is contextual rather than explicit.
notes.manas-2010:p0507:b001:l029: The dying statement is preserved although the speakers survived. It expresses their extremity and is not changed to a completed death.
notes.manas-2010:p0507:b001:l030: Golden cheeks belong to the battle-axe’s sides. Both the axe and the following spear remain in their source display lines.
notes.manas-2010:p0507:b001:l031: Сыр найза: painted/lacquered spear, not a secret spear. No coating material is specified.
notes.manas-2010:p0507:b001:l041: Торчонду is read as people bearing nets, parallel to page 510 lines 33–35; it is not simply the net object. The source’s iron-rope image is retained.
notes.manas-2010:p0508:b001:l003: The battle cry consists of Manas’s name; it is a meaningful translated utterance, not an unresolved foreign cry.
notes.manas-2010:p0508:b001:l010: Кыргын эли каптасын is syntactically unusual. A murderous people surging in is provisional; no corrected numeral or ethnonym is inserted.
notes.manas-2010:p0508:b001:l015: Бейжайлык has an unsettled/abnormal condition sense. Terrible unrest is provisional within the description of Manas’s fury; the term does not transparently specify one action.
notes.manas-2010:p0508:b001:l023: Түмөн is retained as tümen, an epic multitude unit; the indefinite source provides no exact troop total.
notes.manas-2010:p0508:b001:l031: Printed менде is read as the recurring бенде/пенде, mortal, in the invincibility formula. Raw spelling is unchanged.
notes.manas-2010:p0508:b001:l032: The phrase alive and well crosses into the next English line to preserve English syntax; both source display lines remain present and ordered.
notes.manas-2010:p0508:b001:l034: Six days and sixty wounds for Ezkara, seven days and seventy wounds for Zholoy are retained exactly as this speech gives them. They differ from the preceding narrator account on page 505.
notes.manas-2010:p0508:b001:l040: We barely came here to die follows the visibly present өлгөнү. It is not silently repaired to a more idiomatic survived statement.
notes.manas-2010:p0509:b001:l003: Таш сайынган: wearing gemstone rank insignia. The literal stones are retained; no verified grade or mineral is assigned.
notes.manas-2010:p0509:b001:l012: The калдай / калдайтты wordplay couples governor with a sprawling action. The rank is translated rather than mistaken for a named character here.
notes.manas-2010:p0509:b001:l022: Бушманды and the syntax across lines 22–24 are irregular. Grief/anguish is provisional; the accusative ending and interrupted construction remain in the source.
notes.manas-2010:p0509:b001:l028: Kara-Suu of broad Altay is an abrupt geographical phrase in the source. It is not supplied with a missing verb or silently deleted.
notes.manas-2010:p0509:b001:l032: Бейлеп-каным is read as considering/looking carefully plus my khan. The hyphenated source does not establish a new proper name.
notes.manas-2010:p0509:b001:l037: Акыл-ийлеп, literally kneading/shaping thought, is retained as shaping a plan. No tactical details beyond the verse are added.
notes.manas-2010:p0510:b001:l008: Seven days and nights fighting Manas on foot is retained as reported, without reconciliation with forty days or six/seven days elsewhere.
notes.manas-2010:p0510:b001:l010: Октос берсе is interpreted as lunging or springing forward, not firing a modern projectile. Gray tiger preserves the source image.
notes.manas-2010:p0510:b001:l013: Кылым is rendered world/peoples in the destructive-hero formula, not a chronological century. Анткор is deceiver/hypocrite as the hostile speakers’ epithet.
notes.manas-2010:p0510:b001:l016: The alternation between one man and a thousand men is retained as a perception/supernatural image, not a new count of actual fighters.
notes.manas-2010:p0510:b001:l023: Six thousand heroes describes his intimidating presence, not six thousand additional men arriving in the narrative.
notes.manas-2010:p0510:b001:l030: The elders and wrestlers are both retained across lines 30–32. Their enumeration is abrupt; no separate contingent is invented.
notes.manas-2010:p0510:b001:l035: Колчоңду is irregular; read contextually as dagger-bearing/with daggers in their hands, following the plural parallel at page 511 line 1.
notes.manas-2010:p0510:b001:l040: Айкырык сунсак айзанын is irregular. English interprets shouting while leveling spears, and line 41 as the spear shafts breaking at the middle. The precise attachment remains uncertain; no raw repair.
notes.manas-2010:p0511:b001:l005: Ezkara and Zholoy call themselves we two here; the account also names four returning commanders. Both numbers remain as printed.
notes.manas-2010:p0511:b001:l022: The rendered PDF visually joins the end of this line and the start of the next on one baseline (…өлдү.Алтайда…). Extraction provides two separate source segments/IDs; both are retained in provisional lineation.
notes.manas-2010:p0511:b001:l024: Атаңдын көрү is retained as the literal father’s-grave curse, not replaced with a polite exclamation.
notes.manas-2010:p0511:b001:l034: The mild cool autumn is retained as the seasonal setting of this speech; it is not reconciled with other narrated seasons.
notes.manas-2010:p0511:b001:l040: Жекене is a leather belt, not жеке, alone/single combat. Yudakhin and the 2015 explanatory dictionary cite the exact girding formula: https://el-sozduk.kg/жекен/.
notes.manas-2010:p0512:b001:l001: Зың-зың is an imitative humming/whizzing sound; its precise producer is not explicit. The draft follows the hero’s untroubled bearing provisionally.
notes.manas-2010:p0512:b001:l004: Бучкагына is a clothing/leg-hem contempt image. Trouser hem preserves the low valuation without inventing an idiomatic equivalent that loses the material image.
notes.manas-2010:p0512:b001:l006: Bows as rain and shots as hail remain separate and repeated; no modern rate of fire is inferred.
notes.manas-2010:p0512:b001:l010: Кабагым-кашым деген жок expresses not flinching/showing concern. The brow image is retained without literally inventing spoken words.
notes.manas-2010:p0512:b001:l024: Кочкулар is the plural of кочку, Kalmyk village headman in Yudakhin: https://el-sozduk.kg/КОЧКУ/. It is a rank here, not the named Kochku, a dark-red color, or a damaged word for pigs.
notes.manas-2010:p0512:b001:l029: Кырк түтүн means forty households/hearths, not forty individual people. The number is retained.
notes.manas-2010:p0512:b001:l033: The алым / алдырдык contrast is tribute demanded versus loss suffered. What exactly was lost is unspecified; no new material inventory is added.
notes.manas-2010:p0512:b001:l036: Бок is feces/shit. The refusal to give even that is retained in forceful English; it is not softened to nothing.
notes.manas-2010:p0512:b001:l038: Байдасы is visually present; interpreted through пайдасы, benefit/help. Raw source remains unchanged.
notes.manas-2010:p0512:b001:l041: Теликкуш is read as телик куш, young falcon/keen hunting bird, used metaphorically of the departing people or hero. Yudakhin: https://tamgasoft.kg/dict/d-2/word/телик. No separate person named Telikkush is introduced; exact referent remains uncertain.
notes.manas-2010:p0513:b001:l012: Алымың is visibly tribute/your levy, although the sentence also suggests lack of strength. English retains the tribute sense; no silent repair to алыбыз or similar.
notes.manas-2010:p0513:b001:l013: Арада and тороюп are retained as being stiff/stranded between; the exact spatial reference is not supplied.
notes.manas-2010:p0513:b001:l023: The lion biting yet unable to pierce him is retained as invulnerability hyperbole, without treating it as an actual lion fight.
notes.manas-2010:p0513:b001:l034: Канчалык калкын билгидей is rendered literally learning how numerous the people are. A rule/dominate sense of бил- is also possible; the reading remains provisional.
notes.manas-2010:p0514:b001:l018: Чабышкан is rendered with sword combat in contrast to the following spear combat. A broader exchange-of-blows reading is possible.
notes.manas-2010:p0514:b001:l022: Бейпай means misery/hardship in the shared lexical findings. Көйкашка is rendered bold one as a heroic epithet, not a newly introduced name; its precise nuance remains provisional.
notes.manas-2010:p0514:b001:l025: Буурсун is the plow. The agricultural disruption in lines 25 and 30–33 is fully retained rather than reduced to general destruction.
notes.manas-2010:p0514:b001:l030: Шамыян is a wooden/iron pin through an ox-yoke: the 1969/2015 explanatory dictionaries at https://el-sozduk.kg/шам/. The following paired oxen and sowing confirm the concrete agricultural sense.
notes.manas-2010:p0514:b001:l038: Кара саат is a dark/ill-omened hour, not a mechanical clock or a named person.
notes.manas-2010:p0514:b001:l042: His inward breadth extending beyond the earth continues on page 515. The rhetorical interior image is retained.
notes.manas-2010:p0515:b001:l010: Акылын эптеп табыңыз is provisionally finding a way to Manas’s mind/dealing with him, rather than a fully specified offer of peace.
notes.manas-2010:p0515:b001:l020: Капкасы, his gate, is visibly present. It could be a damaged кабагы, brow, but the English does not silently replace it.
notes.manas-2010:p0515:b001:l024: Чоң атасы Каракан is rendered grandfather Karakan; the genealogy is not harmonized with earlier generational counts. The possessive referent in this retrospective account is not fully explicit.
notes.manas-2010:p0515:b001:l025: Абыдан карап калганда visibly means closely looking/watching; the passive watched interpretation follows the surrounding account of the defeated family. A defective кырып reading is possible but not silently substituted.
notes.manas-2010:p0515:b001:l027: The daughter taken as booty is retained without assigning her a name or adding sexual events.
notes.manas-2010:p0515:b001:l031: Кир сөз is literally a dirty/foul saying that stains the heart. The ominous prophecy is retained without sanitizing its extermination command.
notes.manas-2010:p0515:b001:l033: The speech boundary is defective: quoted prophetic counsel leads into Esenkan’s first-person recollection on page 516 without a clear new opening. English distinguishes nested quoted phrases but does not claim independently verified speaker segmentation.
notes.manas-2010:p0515:b001:l042: White deer herded as cattle is retained as impossible power over wild animals, not ordinary livestock.
notes.manas-2010:p0516:b001:l006: Oiled wheat complexion and twilight-mist eyes remain the source’s physical images; no modern racial category is inserted.
notes.manas-2010:p0516:b001:l008: Жалаяк ооз is provisionally broad/gaping mouth, and жар кабак cliff-like brow. The precise facial epithet requires specialist review.
notes.manas-2010:p0516:b001:l010: Жаның чыккан is retained as a curse, may your life depart, rather than factual assertion that Manas died. The source’s second-person intrusion is abrupt.
notes.manas-2010:p0516:b001:l015: Илий (in илий бичик) denotes a Chinese chronicle/genealogical book in the Karalaev epic, per Manas encyclopedia at https://el-sozduk.kg/или/. Sixty leaves remains explicit; it is not treated as the Ili river here.
notes.manas-2010:p0516:b001:l025: Six years earlier is preserved as given. No absolute date or corrected chronology is calculated.
notes.manas-2010:p0516:b001:l026: Бичик is writing/book. The draft translates it rather than treating it as a modern named publication.
notes.manas-2010:p0516:b001:l027: Зыйкырчы is a sorcerer; the unusual initial spelling remains in source. Билгич is seer/knowing person in this prediction context.
notes.manas-2010:p0516:b001:l035: Даңза is the register/record-book. This is an epic account of a prophecy in records, not verification of a surviving historical archive.
notes.manas-2010:p0516:b001:l039: Малдан чачтым баарды retains the expenditure of livestock/wealth. Баарды is irregular and no precise amount is added.
notes.manas-2010:p0517:b001:l006: Дилде is a gold coin. Gold and gold coins are both preserved as the source’s parallel wealth terms.
notes.manas-2010:p0517:b001:l012: The sack stuffed out and straw figure are contemptuous images for the falsely identified captive. The draft does not convert this into an actual manufactured effigy.
notes.manas-2010:p0517:b001:l014: Жок келбеген колунан is visibly irregular; one who could do nothing is a provisional reading from the following worthless/coward/calf parallels.
notes.manas-2010:p0517:b001:l019: Calf is the speaker’s insulting image for the captive, not a new animal brought into the story.
notes.manas-2010:p0517:b001:l030: The claim that the Chinese slaughtered Jakyp’s father belongs to Esenkan’s recollection. It is retained without reconciling other family history.
notes.manas-2010:p0517:b001:l033: Chong Zhindi, literally Big Madman, is the concealment name for Manas. It is not a second son. The proper name is retained without importing an earlier English translation.
notes.manas-2010:p0517:b001:l040: Башаалыктай is read through башалык/бадышалык, royal/rulership, in Yudakhin at https://el-sozduk.kg/?lfrom=ru&lto=ru&page=main&word=БАША. Like a king is contextual; the source’s vowel length is not normalized.
notes.manas-2010:p0518:b001:l018: The flower image and moving/thriving state in lines 18–19 remain together; no fixed proverb is silently supplied.
notes.manas-2010:p0518:b001:l021: Чагаан айы is the first spring/New Year month in the Mongolian calendar according to Yudakhin; the explanatory dictionary also describes the season of abundant milk and young livestock. https://el-sozduk.kg/чага/. No Gregorian month/date is assigned.
notes.manas-2010:p0518:b001:l023: Көөнү келсе is obscure. If the reckoning fits is a provisional linkage between the remembered omen and the birth; raw text remains unrepaired.
notes.manas-2010:p0518:b001:l024: Төрөп is actively giving birth, with mother unstated; English being born follows the subject confirmed in lines 31–33. This is a contextual voice adjustment.
notes.manas-2010:p0518:b001:l027: The clouds reaching and enclosing the earth are retained as the source weather image; exact attachment of курчап is uncertain.
notes.manas-2010:p0518:b001:l028: Eighty days of rain and the earthquake remain explicitly in the omen account. No naturalistic duration correction.
notes.manas-2010:p0518:b003:l001: The speech continues after a two-line bold editorial heading, which is separately preserved and translated, not counted as verse.
notes.manas-2010:p0519:b001:l002: Карыкан is retained as Karykan, distinct from visually different Каракан. No silent consolidation of the two names.
notes.manas-2010:p0519:b001:l003: Six swift horses and a palm-sized letter are separate items in the message dispatch, not six letters.
notes.manas-2010:p0519:b001:l013: Source Каканчындан has ablative -дан. To Beijing of Kakan-Chin follows the recurrent designation, but from Kakan-Chin to Beijing is also possible. This case relation remains uncertain.
notes.manas-2010:p0519:b001:l015: Braid the thoroughbred’s mane is retained as the physical preparatory image. No horse breed is specified.
notes.manas-2010:p0519:b001:l018: Forty doors is retained here without harmonizing with sixty/seventy gates or doors in other speeches.
notes.manas-2010:p0519:b001:l020: Күрмө is a sleeveless outer coat: https://el-sozduk.kg/күрмө/.
notes.manas-2010:p0519:b001:l024: Карыпчы is arm guard per shared lexicon; it is armor, not a rank or weapon.
notes.manas-2010:p0519:b001:l028: Зуу кудук is provisionally retained as Zuu-Kuduk, a place designation. The exact place/temple or well reference remains unverified.
notes.manas-2010:p0519:b001:l041: Караканга канышып is visibly irregular. Clash with Karakan provisionally interprets канышып through кагышып. The apparently incongruous Karakan is retained, not silently replaced by канкор, blood-drinker.
notes.manas-2010:p0520:b001:l006: Чынар is plane tree, not a pine. The precise number of trees is not specified by the Kyrgyz; English uses plural in the garden setting.
notes.manas-2010:p0520:b001:l010: Forty кулач is retained conventionally as forty fathoms/armspans. This is a fantastic fox; no exact metric length is invented.
notes.manas-2010:p0520:b001:l015: Мамытбек is rendered Mamytbek here; page 525 has the spelling Маамытбек, rendered Maamytbek. These are variants of the same one-eyed figure, not two people.
notes.manas-2010:p0520:b001:l017: Кулжадан is read as making a wild ram the sentry, supported by the explicit animal guard on page 523 line 11 and the duck/fox/ram sentinel complex. It is not assigned to the modern city Kulzha.
notes.manas-2010:p0520:b001:l023: Улама is interpreted as transmitted traditional account here; a learned religious-person sense is also possible. No specific scripture is inferred.
notes.manas-2010:p0520:b001:l026: Жайсаң is rendered nobleman, a historical title in this entourage, not the personal name of the singer Zhaysan. Sixty is retained; the precise relation to Alöökö/Kongurbay remains syntactically compressed.
notes.manas-2010:p0520:b001:l027: The ember born from the hearth is a lineage/strength image for the son, not a literal new fire event.
notes.manas-2010:p0520:b001:l028: This year twelve and, in line 30, age seven are preserved exactly; the conditional/inferential force of келгендир is retained as must have.
notes.manas-2010:p0520:b001:l036: The number of mules is unspecified. The slaughter and Karykan’s approval/name-giving remain as narrated; their exact agent linkage is not supplied.
notes.manas-2010:p0520:b001:l039: Керүүгө салган там is retained as a protective house-on-upland metaphor applied to the hero, not a new rank. Керүү means grassy high mountain slope/top in Yudakhin: https://el-sozduk.kg/керүү/. The literal wording permits a constructed house reading, but parallel praise context favors metaphor; the interpretation remains qualified.
notes.manas-2010:p0521:b001:l007: Арбак is spiritual/ancestral potency in this elevation formula. No extra dead ancestor is introduced into the scene.
notes.manas-2010:p0521:b001:l009: Калча is grim/fierce-looking, specifically attested as Kongurbay’s epithet in Yudakhin and Manas encyclopedia: https://el-sozduk.kg/калча/. It is not a second person or a military rank, nor is a Tajik ethnicity asserted here.
notes.manas-2010:p0521:b001:l021: Орот may imply reaping/sweeping down in combat. The draft uses sweeping down provisionally; literal wrapping is also lexically possible.
notes.manas-2010:p0521:b001:l024: Сорот is sucking/drawing in; swallows up preserves the hyperbolic destruction image, not a literal meal.
notes.manas-2010:p0521:b001:l027: Sixty Chinese and сан governors are separate expressions; сан is rendered countless without inventing a numerical total.
notes.manas-2010:p0521:b001:l029: Катал is retained as Katal. The relation of this Karagul passage to the surrounding Kongurbay clauses is abrupt; no identity merger.
notes.manas-2010:p0521:b001:l032: Cutting a spear from reed/cane is retained without specifying bamboo or a metal spearhead.
notes.manas-2010:p0521:b001:l038: Infidel appears within the passage framed as Esenkan’s counsel; the narrative voice may intrude. The religious epithet is retained rather than harmonizing speaker viewpoint.
notes.manas-2010:p0522:b001:l004: The younger brother of sixty noblemen follows инисин literally. This is not harmonized with the compressed sixty-noblemen warrior expression on page 520.
notes.manas-2010:p0522:b001:l007: The wild ram sentry reading follows page 523 line 11; not an unverified modern Kulzha location.
notes.manas-2010:p0522:b001:l010: Ороккыр and Музкиндик are retained as named beings Orokkyr and Muzkindik. No species or extra biography is invented.
notes.manas-2010:p0522:b001:l014: Жер кайгытып is irregular; patrolling the land is provisional from the sentry context and likely кайгы-/кайгуул linkage. Source text is not silently corrected.
notes.manas-2010:p0522:b001:l024: His khan is retained. The draft does not remove the hierarchy merely because Esenkan is himself called khan.
notes.manas-2010:p0522:b001:l036: Каёбоз is retained as Kayoboz; this is not silently unified with a similarly spelled name elsewhere. Pronoun him in the robe/watch clauses provisionally refers to Kongurbay.
notes.manas-2010:p0522:b001:l041: Куу өрдөк is the magical copper-winged duck sentinel, attested in Yudakhin and Manas encyclopedia: https://el-sozduk.kg/өрдөк/ and https://el-sozduk.kg/kuu-ordok/. Cunning is a contextual epithet, not a second swan beside the duck.
notes.manas-2010:p0523:b001:l006: Börü-Koy is retained as the hyphenated place designation. No present-day coordinates are asserted.
notes.manas-2010:p0523:b001:l007: Үзгүлтүк is provisionally treated as the mountain name Üzgültük; the irregular урчукка construction is rendered spur. A descriptive reading of the first word remains possible.
notes.manas-2010:p0523:b001:l011: Кулжа is the wild ram among the magical sentries. It is not the city name in this accusative animal assignment.
notes.manas-2010:p0523:b001:l012: The source turns from the ram to the fox description without an explicit introductory noun until line 17. The it pronouns preserve this transition without silently identifying the two animals.
notes.manas-2010:p0523:b001:l017: The repeated forty-fathom fox and its ability to speak are retained as epic features, not natural-history claims.
notes.manas-2010:p0523:b001:l031: Eight rivers and eighty mountains are both retained. No geographical reconstruction is imposed.
notes.manas-2010:p0523:b001:l033: Секи мойнок is provisionally retained as Seki-Moynok. It may instead describe the shape of a saddle/rise; the reading remains unverified and raw text is preserved.
notes.manas-2010:p0523:b001:l039: Ay Jangjung and Kün Jangjung are proper title-names here, preserved per shared glossary. The generic rank elsewhere is governor-general; the names are not erased by that gloss.
notes.manas-2010:p0524:b001:l004: Калча repeats the grim-looking epithet for Kongurbay; see page 521 line 9.
notes.manas-2010:p0524:b001:l008: Repeated upland-house protective metaphor; see page 520 line 39. The draft does not invent a newly built palace.
notes.manas-2010:p0524:b001:l010: The golden-pillared tent and the following hero phrase are syntactically loose before the speech. Both are retained rather than filling in an unsupported furnishing/gifting verb.
notes.manas-2010:p0524:b001:l012: Two reins and one lead-rope is the image of entrusted command. All three equipment elements are retained.
notes.manas-2010:p0524:b001:l023: The threat to ride him as a black donkey is preserved literally as humiliation, not softened to dismissal.
notes.manas-2010:p0524:b001:l033: My colt is the affectionate/patronizing address to Kongurbay, not a newly introduced horse.
notes.manas-2010:p0524:b001:l040: One khanate from the forty-clan people is retained; the draft does not invent its administrative borders.
notes.manas-2010:p0524:b001:l042: Керишке is read here as combat/contending, consistent with the martial community description. It is not automatically given the unrelated shelter sense of керешке in the working glossary; the vowel distinction matters.
notes.manas-2010:p0525:b001:l001: Кечилдин канын is rendered khanship of the monks in the appointment context; the visually identical blood sense of кан is not selected.
notes.manas-2010:p0525:b001:l005: Коңур is a shortened form of Kongurbay here, rendered Kongur, not a new person.
notes.manas-2010:p0525:b001:l006: The stone worn on the head is a gemstone badge of rank associated with the monks. Its exact material, shape and grade remain unverified.
notes.manas-2010:p0525:b001:l008: The repeated upland-house metaphor remains qualified; see page 520 line 39.
notes.manas-2010:p0525:b001:l015: The rescued object is unstated; us follows Esenkan’s pleas for protection. No new captive is invented.
notes.manas-2010:p0525:b001:l016: The coat that no shot pierces is epic armor praise, not a modern ballistic specification.
notes.manas-2010:p0525:b001:l022: Six thousand Chinese and countless governors are retained, distinct from sixty Chinese on page 521. No numerical harmonization.
notes.manas-2010:p0525:b001:l023: Аксакалы literally elder/white-beard means leader here despite Kongurbay’s reported youth; chief preserves the role without aging him.
notes.manas-2010:p0525:b001:l025: Manguba is retained as the place designation. This begins the description of the one-eyed Mamytbek/Maamytbek, not Kongurbay’s birthplace.
notes.manas-2010:p0525:b001:l029: The single eye is explicitly retained as fantastic anatomy. It is not silently converted into ordinary blindness.
notes.manas-2010:p0525:b001:l031: One whole pig’s meat failing to satisfy a single meal is the source hyperbole; no serving size is inferred.
notes.manas-2010:p0525:b001:l036: Ороо is a storage pit, not an unspecified grave. The nostril comparison remains grotesque and literal.
notes.manas-2010:p0525:b001:l038: Шоро is salt/saline ground; trampled livestock ground is retained. The exact visual texture compared with the eyebrow remains interpretive.
notes.manas-2010:p0525:b001:l041: Маамытбек is the longer spelling of Mamytbek on page 520. Сокур can mean blind or one-eyed; one-eyed is chosen from the explicit single eye in line 29. The spelling difference is preserved, not a new character.
notes.manas-2010:p0525:b001:l042: The portrait continues after the assigned range. No episode ending is manufactured.
